**Subject:** A Fond Farewell

Dear Team,

As my time here comes to an end, I want to thank each of you for your support, collaboration, and kindness—it’s meant more than I can say. I’ll truly miss working alongside such talented and wonderful people. Please stay in touch—I’d love to hear how things continue to grow! Wishing you all success, laughter, and great things ahead. Take care, and goodbye for now.

Best,
[Your Name]
